episodes.synopsis: Cyan Hijirikawa longs to join the band at school, but is too shy. While worrying about it at home, she's transported to another dimension…
episodes.title: Have a nice MUSIC!!

episodes.synopsis: Cyan learns more about Sound World and meets SHINGANCRIMSONZ. She sees the power of music firsthand when she watches them play.
episodes.title: With our crimson gaze... (etc.)

episodes.synopsis: Plasmagica gets entered into a battle of the bands against Criticrista, the hot new all-girl band in Midi City. Will they be able to win?!
episodes.title: Yes! Idol ♡ Declaration

episodes.synopsis: Plasmagica goes to see the concert of a popular band called Tsurezurenaru Ayatsuri Mugenan and are taken in by their originality and stage presence.
episodes.title: Enchanting Dream Fireworks of a Night Journey

episodes.synopsis: Cyan has to fight the dark monsters, but what will she do when she has to choose between performing with her band or protecting Sound World?
episodes.title: Maze of DESTINY

episodes.synopsis: After everyone discovers the truth about Cyan, President Maple proposes a training camp as they prepare new songs for the Grateful Rock Festival.
episodes.title: Ba-dump!? It's a Beach Training Camp ♡ Full of Swimsuits ♪

episodes.synopsis: Something strange is going on at Yokai Street, the hot new spot for street performances. Can Cyan and the others help solve the mystery?
episodes.title: Yokai Street

episodes.synopsis: Plasmagica hasn't performed enough concerts to play in the Grateful Rock Festival, and Aion's gloominess is causing problems with his bandmates.
episodes.title: Cimson Quartet

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Plasmagica's battle of the bands rematch with Criticrista. Will they be able to beat them with their new song?!
episodes.title: Falling Star Dreamline

episodes.synopsis: As Plasmagica practices for the Grateful Rock Festival, Strawberry Heart warns the girls about Dagger's plans, but Chuchu's ambitions take a dark turn...
episodes.title: Reverse Rhapsody

episodes.synopsis: The day of the Grateful Rock Festival has finally come, and as the bands get ready to perform, Cyan worries about the dark monsters...
episodes.title: Grateful Rock Festival

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the final showdown against Dagger! Will Cyan and the others be able to defeat him once and for all?!
episodes.title: Our Youth Is Non-Stop!
